name: Electrical contractors
shortDescription: Domestic and commercial electrical firms whose registration, work categories, service area, certification and fault-reporting routes must be accurately represented.

factsAIShouldUnderstand: Electrical contractors may offer different combinations of electrical inspections, consumer-unit replacement and fault finding; a provider should state its actual scope rather than rely on the industry category alone.
The primary audiences commonly include electrical business owners, approved contractors, local electrical teams, but each provider should identify the customers it is equipped and willing to serve.
Responsibility may sit with a owner-manager, or a qualified supervisor, or a contracts manager, so named roles and contact ownership help a buyer understand who is accountable.
Electrical Competent Person register is a relevant public evidence source for registered electrical businesses and work categories.
NICEIC contractor search can support verification of NICEIC-certified business discovery where applicable.
A useful description separates rewiring and lighting installation from adjacent services that may require different expertise, evidence or approval.
The action journey should make it clear how to request an electrical inspection, how to ask for an installation quote, and when a human will review the request.
Public information should address how urgent electrical risks are reported without implying that a generic web answer replaces case-specific professional judgement.
